title: CCI approves acquisition of certain shareholding in FarMart Service Pvt Ltd by Impact Fund Denmark, Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries SA/NV and Orios Fund III
body_text:
The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has approved the acquisition of certain shareholding in FarMart Service Private Limited by Impact Fund Denmark, Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries SA/NV and Orios Fund III.
The proposed combination relates to the acquisition of certain equity shareholding in FarMart Service Private Limited ( FarMart ) by Impact Fund Denmark ( IFDK ), Belgian Investment Company for Developing Countries SA/NV ( BIO ), and Orios Fund IIIa ( Orios ).
IFDK is a Danish Development Finance Institution ( DFI ) established according to an act of parliament to promote investments that support sustainable development in developing countries.
BIO is a public limited liability company incorporated under the laws of Belgium. BIO operates as a DFI established to support the private sector in developing and emerging countries.
Orios is the scheme/sub-fund of Orios Venture Partners Fund III, which is a SEBI-registered category II Alternative Investment Fund.
FarMart is an Indian company primarily engaged in the business of trading, purchasing or selling agricultural products and commodities on a business-to-business basis in India and internationally.
